children: RNS Number : 2195W  Inqo Investments Limited  24 September 2026
Inqo Investments Limited ("Inqo" or "the Company") is pleased to announce that at its Annual General Meeting held earlier today, all resolutions were passed.
The Directors of Inqo accept responsibility for this announcement.

This announcement contains information which, prior to its disclosure, was inside information as stipulated under Regulation 11 of the Market Abuse (Amendment) (EU Exit) Regulations 2019/310 (as amended).
